name: The No Jumpscare Show
short: In a world where the paranormal is normal and jumpscares are lazy clichés, Illy signs up for a shady haunted house promising true psychological horror. The deal? Survive without getting scared and win $10,000! A totally, 100% jumpscare-free experience :)
about: Welcome to The NO JUMPSCARE Show!   Brought to you by Polypaw, this is a narrative comedy short horror game that promises a 100% jumpscare-free experience! ...Hopefully.            In a world where the paranormal is normal, the horror industry has gotten incredibly lazy.   Jumpscares have become the most boring cliché on earth, and Illy is completely unimpressed. She signs up for a shady haunted house promising true psychological horror...  without  jumpscares? At least, that's what the waiver says.  Run by yours truly, "Thingy the Thing," the kicker is this: if you don't get scared, you'll win $10,000!!  With Illy's constant pushing... things will not end well. And the show will h̷a̷v̷e̷  NOT HAVE ANY JUMPSCARES  = )            Key Features     A Comedy Horror :  A bizarre journey with an unforgettable cast of characters to follow. Sometimes funny, sometimes genuinely terrifying.     Retro & Unique Look:  A beautiful, stylized aesthetic paired with crisp, black-and-white screen-space dither lighting.     Absolutely No... Jumpscares?
